messages:
emma: quick thread 1 proposal for pool presets + bulk-edit for Capacity controls. goal: let users save common min/max/burst/SLO combos as presets, apply to multiple pools at once. prototype: https://redwood.design/s/presets-bulk-v1 :sparkles:
rick: love this. main UX questions: 1) where to surface presets (global toolbar vs per-project picker), 2) how to preview the delta before applying to multiple pools (important for safety).
ashley: my take 1 surface presets in the top-left of the Capacity page as a compact dropdown. choosing a preset should show a diff modal summarizing changes per selected pool with a small `Confirm` CTA. keep the default undo window (5 minutes) and add an `Apply dry-run` option for simulations.
oliver: accessibility and copy: dropdown item labels must be descriptive, e.g., `Web-prod: high-throughput (min=4, max=20, burst=30m, SLO=95%)`. long, but helpful for screen readers. visually we can truncate and show full label on hover.
emma: agree. also thinking about a `Preview changes` inline row in the pool list that shows old vs new values before confirm. compact diff: `Min 2 -> 4`, `Burst off -> 30m`.
rick: edge-case: if a pool is incompatible with a preset (e.g., preset uses GPU typeA but pool is CPU-only), we should gray it out and show a reason tooltip. "Incompatible: GPU type mismatch". do not allow apply.
ashley: keyboard flow: allow multi-select via spacebar, then `p` to open Presets menu. inside the diff modal, arrow keys navigate rows, `Enter` confirms. live region announcements: "3 pools selected, 2 compatible, 1 incompatible". example snippet for live region: `\u003cdiv aria-live=\"polite\" aria-atomic=\"true\"\u003e3 pools selected\u003c/div\u003e`.
oliver: color/contrast: diff arrows use green/red; ensure we don't rely on color alone. add icons (up/down chevrons) and friendly text. also ensure the disabled reason tooltip uses role="status" for screen reader notice.
emma: copy for the diff modal header options:
- Option A: "Preview preset changes"
- Option B: "Review changes before apply"
- Option C: "Confirm preset application"
thoughts?
rick: A or B. A is concise. B is a bit wordier but more explicit. leaning B.
ashley: microcopy for incompatible tooltip: `This preset requires GPUs (A100). This pool doesn't support GPUs.` keep it short.
oliver: add a safety guardrail: when applying a preset that increases max > 2x current, show a warning inline: `Large scale-up: could increase costs significantly. Confirm to proceed.` small link `Estimate cost` opens a cost calc modal. that helps enterprise controls.
emma: good add. also add an opt-out checkbox in the confirm modal: `Apply only to selected pools that match GPU type` vs `Apply and convert incompatible pools to closest match` (conversion flows require infra approval). default to conservative option.
rick: telemetry note: emit events: `preset_applied`, `preset_preview_opened`, `preset_apply_confirmed`, include `incompatible_count`. security: only users with `capacity.admin` role can create/delete presets.
ashley: accessibility nit for steppers in the inline preview: expose `aria-live` updates when a preview value changes, and support keyboard increment via `ArrowUp/ArrowDown`. example aria for stepper button: `button aria-label=\"Increase min for pool web-prod\"`
oliver: dev-bot reminder: automated density check for the updated UI will run once the dropdown is added. also schedule a contrast scan for the diff icons.
dev-bot: note: auto-check scheduled 2026-04-02T18:00Z. result will post here.
emma: action items: 1) Ashley: mock top-left preset dropdown + diff modal (two variants: Preview inline row, Preview modal) 2) Rick: write event list + RBAC rules 3) Oliver: draft accessibility text for labels/tooltip/live regions 4) Emma: short copy options for header and warning text. deadline Tue COB.
ashley: on it, will post frames and a short video of interaction. pinging here when ready :rocket:
rick: will draft telemetry + security bits this afternoon.
oliver: will run quick a11y checklist after frames up.
dev-bot: reminder: density & contrast checks scheduled.
